policy.store: individual source-stated financial facts with a citation and a short DISI paraphrase (<= 400 characters); never publisher text
never_store: a figure from a page that could not be read directly (HTTP 403/404/406)
values inferred from other years, other players or league-wide tiers
a disagreeing report whose resolution has not been reviewed as if it were settled
zero or any placeholder for an unknown amount
policy.pages_read: Every source below was fetched with curl (HTTP 200) and parsed as raw HTML by the author of this migration, not through a summarising fetch tool. The MLB.com and Baseball America pages answered HTTP 403, the Pirates Prospects page 404; none is used and nothing was worked around.
policy.precision_rule: Same as Migrations 030/031: a figure printed with every digit is EXACT; 'approximately' is APPROXIMATE and never selects a canonical value. Disagreeing independent reports both stay ACTIVE (a CONFLICT) and the canonical bonus stays NULL.
